OFFLINE_PROGRESSION_MESSAGE: While you were away, you've generated :
ACHIEVEMENT_LOCKED_HINT: Keep aura farming to unlock this achievement!
SHOP_LOCKED_HINT: Keep aura farming to unlock this!
SHOP_TOO_EXPENSIVE_HINT: You don't have enough aura for this one!
SHOP_COMING_SOON_HINT: This branch isn't open yet, come back later!
SHOP_HELP: Drag to pan · wheel to zoom · hover for details · Shift + click to buy max
SHOP_HUB_ROOT_DESC: Everything starts from the moyai. Each branch leads to a kind of purchase.
SHOP_HUB_OUTFIT_DESC: Dress the statue: every worn piece pays off.
SHOP_TOOLTIP_LOCKED_DESC: Level the previous teaching to 10 to reveal it.
UTILITY_WEAKPOINTS_DESC: Glowing spots appear on the statue. Click them for a critical hit that pumps the combo.
UTILITY_DOOMSCROLL_DESC: A phone appears next to the statue. Every post you scroll past wins (green) or loses (red) aura and pumps the combo. Golden posts drop a chest.
UTILITY_TRICKSHOT_DESC: A rare shot on click that sends the combo flying.
UTILITY_WEAKPOINTS_HINT: Watch for glowing spots on the statue: click them for a critical hit!
UTILITY_DOOMSCROLL_HINT: Scroll on the phone next to the statue… at your own risk.
UTILITY_TRICKSHOT_HINT: Keep clicking: a trickshot can go off at any moment.
COLLECTION_SHOP_LEAD: Spend your gems to complete the collection. Never the same figure twice.
CALM_NOTE: Turns the effects off: no speed lines, no flashing, the feed stops scrolling. Amounts and colours stay.
CALL_JOHN_ANSWERED: “Hello, John Pork here. Just calling to say your aura looks clean.”
CALL_JOHN_HUNG_UP: John Pork heard the click. He said nothing. He will remember.
CALL_JOHN_MISSED: Missed call from John Pork. No message.
CALL_COLONEL_ANSWERED: “AT EASE, SOLDIER.” The Colonel decorates you for service to the feed.
CALL_COLONEL_HUNG_UP: Hanging up on an officer goes straight to the disciplinary board.
CALL_COLONEL_MISSED: The Colonel let it ring. Twice. Then he gave up.
CALL_LARRY_HUNG_UP: Good call. Larry puts the phone down, disappointed.
CALL_LARRY_MISSED: Larry let it ring out. He knows where you sleep.
COLLECTION_NOT_ENOUGH_GEMS: You need more gems for this chest!
STAT_AUTOSCROLL: The phone scrolls by itself, non-stop.
UTILITY_SPIN_DESC: The statue keeps its momentum longer once launched: the combo holds better.
UTILITY_SPIN_HINT: Fling the statue: it spins for longer now!
STAT_AUTOSPIN: The statue spins by itself, forever: the combo stays hot at all times.
COLLECTION_RELICS_LEAD: One trophy per boss, taken at its first defeat. Their bonuses multiply together.
UTILITY_PROSPECT_DESC: Gems drop more often on click, and critical hits yield more of them.
UTILITY_PROSPECT_HINT: Keep clicking: gems drop far more often now.
UTILITY_SLUMBER_DESC: You keep farming while away: the offline cap rises, and the rate with it.
UTILITY_SLUMBER_HINT: Come back tomorrow: your aura will have kept climbing while you were away.
BATTLE_LEAD: Face the brainrots with dice. Your damage comes from your total production, not from the teaching you pick: what matters is the bet you make on the roll.
BATTLE_LOCKED_HINT: You must take down the previous boss first.
BATTLE_NO_ACTION_HINT: Buy at least one teaching before fighting.
BATTLE_PICK_HINT: Read what he is winding up, then pick your move. A Mog is rolled on a {{faces}}-sided die.
BATTLE_LOST_HINT: Raise your aura per second and come back.
QUEST_DAILY_LEAD: Three a day, reset at midnight.
QUEST_STORY_DONE: The story is over. The moyai took back what was his.
QUEST_EXILE_LORE: Your brother floored you with one look, in front of everyone. The succession is his. You get up with zero aura and a jawline.
QUEST_JAWLINE_LORE: No shortcuts. Back to basics: the jawline check, a thousand times if that's what it takes.
QUEST_PIGEON_LORE: A pigeon in a trench coat sidles up. He has human feet and an opinion on everything. He says he knows a way to farm.
QUEST_BATTLES_LORE: Word is a fallen moyai is climbing back. The local brainrots want to see for themselves.
QUEST_FIRST_BLOOD_LORE: A shark in sneakers blocks your way, singing. He won't be singing long.
QUEST_GEMS_LORE: The pigeon explains gems in three sentences and asks for two of them. You're starting to understand his business model.
QUEST_SHOWCASE_LORE: Six figures on the shelf. That's not vanity, that's a résumé.
QUEST_RUMOUR_LORE: Five brainrots down. Nobody says “Chad's brother” any more, they say your name.
QUEST_COMPANY_LORE: A corgi has been following you for three days. You've stopped saying no.
QUEST_TROPHIES_LORE: Ten relics in a row. Each has a name, a smell, and a story nobody wants to hear twice.
QUEST_NAMEK_LORE: This one isn't from the feed. He's been waiting, arms crossed, from another planet.
QUEST_SIX_SEVEN_LORE: You spin so fast the number stops on 6.7. The pigeon screams. You don't know why.
QUEST_THRESHOLD_LORE: Chad never drops below it. Until you're there, you don't exist to him.
QUEST_SUCCESSION_LORE: He unfurls his aura. His lackeys collapse before you even look up. This time you don't lower your head.
STORE_PITCH: John Pork is holding shop. Gems only.
STORE_SAY_BROKE: Not enough gems for that one, pal.
STORE_DRINKS_LEAD: A can boosts production and clicks for its whole duration. One at a time: your heart couldn't take more.
STORE_DRINK_HINT: Bottoms up! Your aura is climbing for a while.
UTILITY_DICE_DESC: A share of your battle rolls come up 20 automatically.
UTILITY_DICE_HINT: Your dice are loaded: some rolls will land on 20 by themselves.
OFFLINE_CAPPED: Capped at {{hours}} h — upgrade Slumber to go further.
ONBOARD_INTRO_1: Hey. Your aura is in the red: let me explain.
ONBOARD_INTRO_2: Click me to farm aura. Spin me while you do it, that multiplies the gain.
ONBOARD_INTRO_3: With aura, open the shop below and buy teachings: they produce for you.
ONBOARD_BATTLES: You're strong enough: aura battles are open. Click here!
BATTLE_MANUAL_DAMAGE: Your damage comes from your total aura per second, not from the level of the teaching you pick. Each teaching you buy takes a role, cycling: the first mogs, the second soaks, the third heals.
BATTLE_MANUAL_COOLDOWN: A move you play recharges for two turns. Buying more teachings means several cards of the same role, and never being caught out.
BATTLE_COOLDOWN_HINT: That attack is still charging, take another one.
INTENT_STRIKE_DESC: A normal hit. Time to mog him.
INTENT_CHARGE_DESC: Triple damage if it lands. Go NPC to soak it.
INTENT_GUARD_DESC: He takes half damage and hits weakly. Use it to looksmax.
BATTLE_MANUAL_INTENT: The boss announces his move before you choose. That is where the fight is decided.
BATTLE_MANUAL_MOG: attack. You each roll a {{faces}}-sided die: the higher one lands the hit, the other takes it.
BATTLE_MANUAL_NPC: defence. No roll: you only take 30 % of the damage, this turn and the next. The answer to a charge.
BATTLE_MANUAL_LOOKSMAX: heal. You recover 30 % of your missing health, but you still take the hit. Decisive when low, useless at full.
BATTLE_MANUAL_ENRAGE: His damage rises 3 % every turn: you cannot stall forever, you have to close the fight.
UTILITY_COMBO_DESC: The spin multiplier climbs higher, holds longer and starts higher.
UTILITY_COMBO_HINT: Spin the statue: your combo climbs higher than before.
WARDROBE_BRAINROTS_NOTE: The ones you beat take the statue's place. Accessories do not follow them.
BATTLE_OWNED: Beaten — wear it from the wardrobe
SHOP_HUB_STORE_DESC: Opens the moyai merchant's shelves, and the companions that stand beside you.
SHOP_SHELF_CHEST_DESC: Puts this chest on sale at the merchant, for gems.
SHOP_SHELF_DRINK_DESC: Puts this can on the shelf: ×{{multiplier}} for {{minutes}} min, for gems.
SHOP_COMPANION_DESC: Stands beside the statue: +{{value}} % production, forever.
STORE_LOCKED: Nothing on the shelves yet. Open them in the Merchant branch of the tree.
COMPANION_VERMOUTH_HINT: Vermouth follows you everywhere now. Good dog.
COMPANION_BUTTERFLY_HINT: A butterfly knife. Don't cut yourself.
COMPANION_MOTO_HINT: The bike is parked beside you. The noise alone earns aura.
COMPANION_CIGARETTES_HINT: The pack is sitting there. You don't smoke, you pose.
COMPANION_RACECAR_HINT: A race car, purely for show.
COMPANION_BRAULO_HINT: Braulo chose you. He earns the most of all.
STAT_AKIMBO: A second phone on the other side of the screen: two feeds at once.
COMPANION_IVANK_HINT: Ivank is parked there. Nobody will bother you.
COMPANION_MAKOUILLE_HINT: Makouille has joined Braulo. The pair is complete.
GRAPHICS_NOTE: Power saving lowers the resolution, turns off anti-aliasing and freezes the small decorative statues. It fully applies to scenes opened afterwards.

SAVE_IMPORT_CONFIRM: This save will replace your current game. The game will restart.
CASINO_ROULETTE_LEAD: Pick a colour and spin the wheel.
SHOP_CASINO_DESC: Opens the casino: roulette and crash, where you wager your gems.
SHOP_CASINO_HINT: The casino is open. Wager your gems, or don't.
CASINO_CRASH_LEAD: The arrow climbs and multiplies your bet. Cash out before it crashes.
CASINO_REVEALING: How far would it have gone?
STORE_HEART_ATTACK: Do you want a heart attack? One can at a time.
STORE_FOOD_FULL: You're still full. Finish your meal first.
STORE_FOOD_HINT: Enjoy your meal! Your aura is digesting.
STORE_FOODS_LEAD: Gentler than a can but much longer. One dish at a time, on top of a can.
SHOP_SHELF_FOOD_DESC: Puts this dish on the menu: ×{{multiplier}} for {{minutes}} min, for gems.
SHOP_COMPANION_PHONES_DESC: Every companion doomscrolls with you: +{{value}} % doomscroll payout per companion (+{{total}} % with the whole crew).
SHOP_COMPANION_PHONES_HINT: The whole crew has a phone now. Everyone is scrolling.
WARDROBE_SKINS_NOTE: The material of figures found in chests, to apply to the statue.
